text.description_html:
First Impressions 3622 Contemporary Mitered Glass Shower Hook

This contemporary designed shower door hook is constructed of durable stainless steel and finished in bright polished finish. Sleek mitered 90 degree angle adds to the shower door hook's clean fresh look.

Can be mounted to a glass shower door or to a glass wall panel - easy to install. Comes complete with all the glass mounting hardware and decorative screw cover.

Specifications of First Impressions 3622Contemporary Glass Mount Hook

  • Hook Diameter: 1"
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Polished

Packaged with all the hardware for mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass.

*Sold Individually
